sources.title: Cuba Travel: regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's current official tourism portal states that a tourist visa is mandatory for a non-resident, identifies Chinese citizens as the visa-exempt exception, and says the electronic tourist visa can be obtained online from anywhere outside the United States.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The tourist visa is mandatory ... if you do not have Cuban residency; it is requested through the Internet from anywhere except the United States.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as the only visa-application website officially recognised and approved by the State of Côte d'Ivoire; its route is expressly for valid ordinary passports and says that the visa is printed and issued at the airport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La demande ... est valable uniquement pour les détenteurs de passeports ordinaires ... le visa est imprimé et délivré immédiatement [à] l'aéroport.

policies.title: Syrian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's current official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Syrian visitor and provides an electronic tourist-visa route online from anywhere outside the United States.
conditions: This is the ordinary Syrian-passport tourist route described by Cuba's general valid-passport rule. It does not infer recognition of a particular issuing authority, obsolete document, special passport or residence status; carry a document valid for Cuba's stated six-month period.

Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel and complete the separate D'Viajeros declaration. The tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, extendable for a further 90 days. Work, residence, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Apply for the electronic tourist visa with a valid ordinary Syrian passport before departure.
Complete the separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration and travel with the resulting visa code and required travel documents.

policies.title: Syrian ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official valid-ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Syrian passport and complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload. Board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.

At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa. Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the valid ordinary Syrian passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

conflicts.explanation: The official valid-ordinary-passport process requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport; under the taxonomy, online preapproval followed by border issuance is visa_on_arrival.
